name: Game profiles
description: Ready-made key mapping profiles for popular games. They show up when the game is on screen and has no profile yet.

permissions.name: input.read
permissions.reason: The Star Rail profiles switch between exploring and combat on the ` key and pause detection on F8.

permissions.name: mapping
permissions.reason: The Star Rail profiles turn their combat-mode switch on and off, which changes the keys.

permissions.name: device.screen
permissions.reason: The Star Rail profiles read a few words on screen to tell whether a battle is on.
